gcaiBaseUrl.title: GreenChemistry.ai destination
gcaiBaseUrl.description: Destination for the reviewed manual handoff.

gcaiBridge.title: GCai private review connection
gcaiBridge.description: Disabled by default. Signed-in GCai account required. Private review and final choice remain in the popup. Create-new uses exact target/evidence readback; update-existing and SMTP guest recovery are unavailable. Source retention remains up to 90 days.

enabled.title: Enable connection to GCai receiver
enabled.description: Opens the secure popup. Leave off to use the reviewed clipboard handoff instead. Once enabled, every reviewed source submitted through this add-on triggers a GCai connection.

deadlineMs.title: Connection timeout (milliseconds)
deadlineMs.description: Fixed 65-minute listener lifetime. Parent integration must provide at least 67-minute backend credentials (subject to verified guest expiry).
